what: The previous section is pinned in its fully read position, and during the one screen-height of scroll while this section’s top edge rises from the bottom of the screen, the inner photo (1.06 → 1x) and text frame descend from above by screen height and settle in place — it looks like a photo stopped on screen opening from below like a curtain that covers the previous section. Meanwhile the previous section’s inside is pushed up −25% (no curve, tied directly to scroll). 1025px and up

options.push: Share of the previous panel’s inner side that gets pushed, default −25 — 0 means no push
options.z: Stacking order of this Section, default 2 — raise to 3, 4… when curtains follow in a row
options.under: Selector of the previous section to cover, default the immediately preceding sibling
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Text frame that comes down with it (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=pushed]: Element to be pushed within the front Section (optional) — if omitted, the front Section’s first child

from.where: index.js curtain() — original agnes-anim-2 piece·woman·sustainability: the previous section is pinned (pinSpacing false) from dwell start to this section’s top, rectDrive(1 − top/vh) moves media y −vh→0·scale 1.06→1, frame y −vh→0, previous collection yPercent 0→−25, desktop only (1025px and up)
